## Context / Problem
Eighteen Python modules under `tests/unit` contain 40 audited prose blocks: 22 leading docstrings and 18 full-line comments. Scope was revalidated against `origin/main@9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45`. Since the original audit, the nested-pytest basetemp guard, close-precheck helper name, and failed-call seam changed; this plan preserves their current forms. The vague `test_ticket_project_fields.py:1-13 and held-out narration` scope is replaced by exact IDs.

## Approach
Edit only the stable-ID blocks below. Capture immutable before/final blobs for every owned path and parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. On comparison copies, remove only an allowlisted leading `Expr(Constant(str))` that is the first statement of a `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, or `AsyncFunctionDef`; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require the remaining normalized ASTs to match.

Tokenize both blobs and reject every changed inline comment or non-allowlisted full-line comment. Preserve non-docstring runtime strings, regexes, prompts, imports, decorators, annotations, assertions, subprocess arguments, test data, shebangs, and complete directive-bearing physical lines exactly. Adjacent blank-line normalization is allowed only around an edited block.

## Stable block allowlist
- `tests/unit/test_sync_narrow_refspec.py`: `D:<module>`

  - `C:<module>:before:def test_three_states_are_distinguishable_after_replay`
  - `C:test_three_states_are_distinguishable_after_replay:before:assert absent.get("bridge_project") is None`
  - `C:test_three_states_are_distinguishable_after_replay:before:assert absent.get("bridge_project") != empty["bridge_project"]`

`D:<symbol>` is a true leading docstring. `C:<scope>:before:<code>` is one maximal contiguous full-line block before unchanged code. No other prose is editable.

## Protected false positives
Keep exact three already-concise behavioral docstrings in `test_ticket_project_fields.py`: `D:test_three_states_are_distinguishable_after_replay`, `D:test_bridge_project_and_repos_are_parity_across_surfaces`, and `D:test_promote_only_refuses_rebind_but_allows_first_set`. Also keep exact the force-exemption comments before the frozen `e6_selfconsistency_inputs.jsonl` cohort, `CHANGELOG.md`, and this test file; they are short, load-bearing reasons rather than bloat.

## Preserved contracts and consumers
- Sync keeps explicit narrow-refspec fetch, provenance-based union/adopt, orphan refusal, reachability, and aggressive-gc safety.
- Import/typecheck/threshold guards keep bare-pytest behavior, scripts scope, every approved threshold/posture, and the new isolated basetemp.
- Ticket fields keep absent/empty/key states, CLI/library/MCP parity, promote-only refusal, legacy defaults, and a clear held-out boundary.
- Timeout coverage keeps full-phase enforcement, the 29.93-second measured floor, 2x headroom, thread-watchdog failure mode, and marker overrides.
- Close/force coverage keeps quiet commit matching, current `close_precheck._referencing_commits`, durable signing/force/provenance causes, text warnings, one reason-bearing force option, loud retired-spelling rejection, and exact exemptions.
- Retry/trust/cache/usage coverage keeps equal jitter, below-agent-loop no-duplicate retry, most-recoverable throttle classification, pinned-key/era checks, unique atomic writes, unsigned-writer detection, and current `run_shape()` failed-call logging.
- All owned modules are direct pytest inputs. `test_ci_workflow_parity.py` explicitly collects the import/timeout guards; `test_nested_pytest_uniqueness.py` scans the bare-pytest launch; the force test scans tracked source. No target import, `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, or pydoc consumer was found.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only declared stable-ID blocks and adjacent blank lines change; normalized-AST and token/comment comparisons pass on every owned path.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and retains its listed current contract while removing chronology, duplication, obvious narration, or separator ornament.
- [ ] An independent reviewer posts one leaf-linked TSV row per block: `stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
- [ ] Every expected row has immutable citations and `directives_exact=PASS`, `semantic-preservation=PASS`, and `bloat-removal=PASS`; missing/failing rows block closure.
- [ ] All five structured verify commands pass.

## Verification
The five DD-level commands recorded on this ticket run focused pytest (including named consumers), scoped Ruff check plus format-check, comment hygiene, owned-path `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify`. They are the executable completion oracle.


Current-scope correction: 2 one-word labels (`# CLI`, `# Library`) are already minimal, so they remain protected rather than becoming empty comments. The live allowlist contains 40 editable blocks (22 D + 18 C).
